card.name: Should be carefully considered/monitored
card.fires_on: The word 'be' or 'carefully' right after 'should' in label warnings about reintroducing therapy or monitoring after stopping a drug. Also fires on a few partway-through-name pieces of foreign surnames.

modes.label: Should be carefully/closely
modes.description: 'be' or 'carefully' after 'should' just before 'carefully considered' or 'closely monitored'.
modes.example: the potential reintroduction of drug therapy should<< be>> carefully considered.

modes.label: Inside foreign surnames
modes.description: Middle piece of a Polish or Lithuanian personal name in history text.
modes.example: the pharmacist Antanas Tr<<usk>>is hid the Jewish doctor Kovalsky

card.plain: It marks the 'should be carefully considered/monitored' phrasing in warnings, and occasionally the middle of an unusual surname.
